notes.title: GOLFTOPIA: Tournaments Update 0.3.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=jKTuY8OzGh4;full][/previewyoutube]
GolfTopia update 0.3.0 brings tournaments!  Every 10 game days you may compete in a tournament.  First, second, and third place winners earn huge cash rewards, so be sure to get out there and practice.  New decorative items like colored lights and jump jet fountains are included in this update, among several other tweaks, fixes, and additions.

notes.title: Fancy Pants Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=dQ4hgEdqLvE;full][/previewyoutube]
GolfTopia update 0.2.0 is here!  Skill based shot variation allows golfers of different skill levels to play differently, cutting corners, taking shortcuts, or playing it safe when their skills are sub-par.  Golfers have evolved their skills to include curve balls (draw / fade) and back-spin shots to overcome your nightmarish hole designs and rage inducing obstacles.  New devices have been added, manual par editing, hole renaming, and much more!  Check out the video to see these new features in greater detail.
